pages.title: Farm to Factory
pages.text: Food here touches seasons, Create machines, pollution and thirst. These are the links worth knowing before you build a big farm.

**Seasons decide what grows.** Most crops only grow in some seasons. Greenhouses and underground farms get around it.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Crops by Season](entry://survival/seasons_crops)[#]().

**Create farms and cooks.** Harvesters and ploughs on [#](2E5AAC)[contraptions](entry://create_basics/contraptions)[#]() reap fields, Slice & Dice's Sprinkler spreads Liquid Fertilizer, and Central Kitchen lets arms and deployers run Farmer's Delight pots and boards.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Kitchen Automation](entry://food/kitchen_automation)[#]().

**Sulfur kills crops.** Sulfur smog and its rain kill crops, berry bushes and bee nests and turn farmland to podzol. Keep burners away from fields, or filter their exhaust.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Pollution](entry://survival/pollution)[#]().

**Water for drinking** can come from Create too: a pumped Sand Filter purifies it, and [#](7A3C9A)[compacting](entry://glossary/compacting)[#]() cactus gives clean water.\
\
**Bees** link in through Enchantment Industry's super experience.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Thirst](entry://survival/thirst)[#](), [#](2E5AAC)[Bees](entry://food/bees)[#]().
